2034-4365-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4365-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1770-2226-6408.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-6408.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Storm Sculptor by paying its mana cost.
When Storm Sculptor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

339-574-677-6791.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
339-574-677-6791.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

2403-4279-5687--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2403-4279-5687--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake, Skittering Precursor and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

855-2438-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
855-2438-5254.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

765-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Guildless Commons from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

813-4377-5144.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Scholar of the Ages and exiling Ephemerate.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

206-579-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
206-579-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

944-1824-2530-2932.manaNeeded: {B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
944-1824-2530-2932.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
944-1824-2530-2932.description:
Cast Acererak either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

252-1575-5686-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
252-1575-5686-5776.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur in addition to its other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Repeat.
252-1575-5686-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

985-3459-5078-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

681-5411-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5411-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

539-4178-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two Forests other than Magus of the Candelabra that can tap for mana.
539-4178-4657.description:
Activate two Forests other than Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}.
Nissa triggers twice, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-4853-6798.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1494-5636-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-5875.description:
Activate Essence Channeler by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Essence Channeler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

280-1399-1606-4452.description:
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

2103-2707-4183-6504.manaNeeded: {U}{R} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
2103-2707-4183-6504.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Capture of Jingzhou onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

222-2018-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities from steps 1 and 6.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1912-4499-5422.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking The Third Doctor.
When The Third Doctor enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4377-5913-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Pinnacle Monk by paying its mana cost.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Pinnacle Monk from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

855-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
855-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

803-2783-3510.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2783-3510.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Arcane Adaptation, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

687-1451-2034-3818.notablePrerequisites: Pyreheart Wolf does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-1451-2034-3818.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Pyreheart Wolf trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Pyreheart Wolf.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 5, causing you to mill three cards and returning Pyreheart Wolf from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2366-2882-4552.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Blossoming Tortoise.
2034-2366-2882-4552.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield as a copy of Blossoming Tortoise due to Infinite Reflection, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dryad Arbor trigger from step 2, causing you to mill three cards and return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

876-2703-2792-4116.notablePrerequisites:
Myr Propagator and Great Whale have at least one counter on them.
Lightning Greaves attached to Volrath.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {6}.
876-2703-2792-4116.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Myr Propagator until end of turn.
Activate Volrath by paying {3} and tapping it.
Holding priority, activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Great Whale until end of turn.
Resolve the Volrath ability from step 3, creating a token copy of it that is a copy of Great Whale.
The Volrath token enters the battlefield, untapping the seven lands.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Volrath token.
Repeat.

914-2292-2815-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Treasure.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2292-2815-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Mortuary, causing you to put Dockside Extortionist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, exiling Dockside Extortionist from the top of your library and allowing you to cast it from exile this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist from exile by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

262-3038-4688.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Colossification attached to the same creature.
The creature with Elemental Mastery and Colossification attached does not have summoning sickness.
262-3038-4688.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate the creature with Colossification and Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating at least twenty 1/1 Elementals with haste.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

225-539-907-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1358-4222-5116.notablePrerequisites: Gilded Lotus does not have summoning sickness.
1358-4222-5116.description:
Activate Sydri by paying {U}, causing Gilded Lotus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Freed from the Real by paying {2}{U}, enchanting Gilded Lotus.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
